text:
maya: Heads-up — premerge job finished for release/feature/response-rerank. eval-bot flagged a regression on the conversational-quality eval set.

eval-bot: automated check results: conversational-quality: -3.1% (p<0.01), safety-check: pass, latency: +10ms. failing prompt groups: greeting-coherence, long-context-summary.

zach: ugh. Is that within the tolerance we set for this release window?

maya: our threshold is -2.0% for conv-quality. so this is over.

sophia: Can we triage quickly? Is it a model behavior shift or a prompt template change?

maya: runs look like model variant change — v2.3.1 -> v2.4.0. No prompt changes in this branch.

ray: @maya can you pin the canary to v2.3.1 while we investigate? I'd prefer a short rollback/pin rather than risking a rollout.

deploy-bot: action required — release attempt blocked by eval-gate. Options: [pin-to-stable], [promote-anyway-with-manual-override], [abort]. Use commands or ask an approver.

zach: I recommend pin. We have the change window until 18:00 UTC but don't want noisy regressions live.

sophia: Agree. Also request a focused eval run on the failing prompt groups with the prior model to confirm delta.

maya: running focused eval now and uploading logs to the ticket: https://redwood/infra/tickets/RE-4231

maya: to pin: `redwoodctl pin model response-rerank --version v2.3.1 --route canary` — applying now.

deploy-bot: executed `pin` — canary pinned to v2.3.1. Promotion blocked. :white_check_mark:

eval-bot: focused eval (greeting-coherence,long-context-summary): delta vs v2.3.1 = -3.4% and -2.9% respectively. full logs: https://redwood/ci/evals/1781209876

ray: ok that confirms. Who will triage the model change? Looks like kernel optimization might have altered attention norm.

maya: assigning to @sophia for initial root cause, @zach to prepare rollback notes if required for the release notes.

sophia: starting root cause investigation. Will post findings within the hour. If we need emergency rollback across Dedicated customers, we should schedule a quick change window and inform SRE.

oncall-bot: @eng-sre notified about potential rollback requirement — please monitor canary telemetry.

zach: I'll draft a rollback/incident blurb for release notes and customer comms. tagging @maya for approval.

maya: thanks. Once triage confirms the regression source, we can decide whether to patch v2.4.0 or revert the runtime optimization. For now, pin stays. :thumbsup:

sophia: update — local repro shows attention scaling tweak in runtime commit abc123. Will test reverting that patch.

maya: perfect. leave this thread open, will close when patch is validated and eval-gate clears (or we decide to promote).
